title: Regular unit and quotient cocycle normalization
statement: The finite dualizing regular unit agrees with the normalized origin scalar unit at an identity quotient. For successive quotients r≥m≥n, compact-support comparisons compose through the canonical scalar associator, and the regular unit comparisons compose through the same associator.

proof.text: Identify the representative-normalized scalar unit with the derived adjunction transpose of the ordinary lax restriction unit in degree zero. The cochain adjunction-unit formula and exact-single comparison give this identification. At an identity ring map, the ordinary restriction unit is the inverse canonical restriction identity. Exact degree-zero identity coherence and the left-adjoint identity mate give the normalized origin scalar unit.

Use the successive-scalar equation for extension by zero, identifying its fixed comparison with ExceptionalCoefficients.openIso by the established open-unit normalization. Paste the direct-image coefficient-chain equation, move the open comparison through the natural direct-image scalar mate, and cancel the scalar compositor with its inverse. This gives the compact-support equation for arbitrary coefficients and inputs, and then for the specified quotient maps.

The ordinary lax restriction units compose: on sections this is composition of the two ring homomorphisms. Apply the exact degree-zero scalar-adjunction insertion composition law to these three ordinary units. The canonical left-adjoint compositor is the specified pbcFixedScalarExtensionComp. Specialize by the proved finiteDualizingQuotient_comp equality; no flatness or boundedness hypothesis is used.

theorem finiteDualizing_quotient_normalization :
    (∀ n : ℕ, (Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.unitIso
        (finiteDualizingQuotient l E (le_refl n)) (Spec (.of D.k))).hom =
      (ProEtale.normalizedOriginScalarUnit (Spec (.of D.k)).smallEtaleTopology _
        (finiteDualizingQuotient_id l E n)).hom.app
          (Etale.constantComplex (finiteDualizingCoeff l E n) (Spec (.of D.k)))) ∧
    (∀ {r m n : ℕ} (hrm : m ≤ r) (hmn : n ≤ m)
      (K : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (finiteDualizingCoeff l E r) X),
      (Etale.scalarExtension (finiteDualizingQuotient l E hmn) (Spec (.of D.k))).map
          (Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.compactSupportMap
            (finiteDualizingQuotient l E hrm) (finiteDualizingCompactification D X) K) ≫
        Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.compactSupportMap (finiteDualizingQuotient l E hmn)
          (finiteDualizingCompactification D X)
          ((Etale.scalarExtension (finiteDualizingQuotient l E hrm) X).obj K) ≫
        (finiteDualizingEtaleSupport l E D X n).map
          ((ProEtale.pbcFixedScalarExtensionComp X.smallEtaleTopology _ _ _
            (finiteDualizingQuotient_comp l E hrm hmn)).hom.app K) =
      (ProEtale.pbcFixedScalarExtensionComp (Spec (.of D.k)).smallEtaleTopology _ _ _
        (finiteDualizingQuotient_comp l E hrm hmn)).hom.app
          ((finiteDualizingEtaleSupport l E D X r).obj K) ≫
        Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.compactSupportMap
          (finiteDualizingQuotient l E (hmn.trans hrm))
          (finiteDualizingCompactification D X) K) ∧
    (∀ {r m n : ℕ} (hrm : m ≤ r) (hmn : n ≤ m),
      (Etale.scalarExtension (finiteDualizingQuotient l E hmn) (Spec (.of D.k))).map
          (Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.unitIso (finiteDualizingQuotient l E hrm)
            (Spec (.of D.k))).hom ≫
        (Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.unitIso (finiteDualizingQuotient l E hmn)
          (Spec (.of D.k))).hom =
      (ProEtale.pbcFixedScalarExtensionComp (Spec (.of D.k)).smallEtaleTopology _ _ _
        (finiteDualizingQuotient_comp l E hrm hmn)).hom.app
          (Etale.constantComplex (finiteDualizingCoeff l E r) (Spec (.of D.k))) ≫
        (Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.unitIso (finiteDualizingQuotient l E
          (hmn.trans hrm)) (Spec (.of D.k))).hom)
